purpose: Integrity, regression, and representative-fixture validation contract for the shared Hero-Soldier Relation Layer before any generated relation set or bidirectional index may be accepted for downstream use.

validationArtifact.publicationGate: The A-6 relation set and A-7 indexes are not production-ready until this validation artifact records PASS for the exact same relation-set blob SHA.

severityPolicy.FAIL: Semantic or structural contract violation. Output must not be consumed downstream.
severityPolicy.REVIEW: No semantic invariant is known to be broken, but frozen-baseline counts or fixture snapshot evidence changed and require explanation as legitimate client-data/source evolution before acceptance.
severityPolicy.PASS: All hard invariants pass and any baseline differences are either absent or explicitly classified as legitimate source changes.
severityPolicy.rule: A REVIEW may not be silently promoted to PASS. The validation artifact must record the reason and evidence for the classification.

identity: Every edge.heroId exists in the canonical Hero Master used by the relation set.
Every edge.soldierId exists in the canonical Soldier Master used by the relation set.
No duplicate canonical (heroId, soldierId) pair exists.
No relation is repaired or joined by names, site IDs, numeric offsets, tier, army type or ordering.
edgeSchema: Canonical edges contain only A-4 semantic fields; forbidden presentation/classification metadata must not be embedded.
Serialized edge and provenance ordering follows the deterministic A-4 rules.
provenance: Every provenance.sourceKind is allowed by A-3.
Every DIRECT provenance uses the authoritative table and field defined for that sourceKind.
Every SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT provenance has a valid parentEdge and explicit SP_FORM_LINK.
SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND provenance is never inherited to another form.
sourceCompleteness: Every valid BASE_SOLDIER_HERO source member produces the expected canonical pair with matching direct provenance.
Every valid SP_HERO_REWARD source member produces the exact listed Soldier target pair with matching direct provenance.
Every valid SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND source member produces the SP Soldier pair with matching direct provenance.
Every eligible normal-form DIRECT provenance produces the required SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT candidate when an explicit SP_FORM_LINK exists.
No canonical pair exists without at least one derivation path permitted by A-3 and A-5.
composition: Candidate production is normalized to exact (heroId, soldierId) pairs before union.
Multiple production paths for one pair merge provenance instead of creating duplicate edges.
Normal-form relations do not inherit backward from SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND.
SP_FORM_LINK alone never creates a Hero-Soldier edge.
Source iteration order does not alter the semantic pair set or provenance set.
summary: relation-set summary.heroCount equals distinct heroId count in edges.
relation-set summary.soldierCount equals distinct soldierId count in edges.
relation-set summary.provenanceCount equals the total number of provenance entries after deduplication.
sourceProductionCounts are derived from provenance and are not used as semantic input.
indexes: Both A-7 indexes reference the exact same validated relation-set blob SHA.
The pair set reconstructed from byHeroId exactly equals canonical edges.
The pair set reconstructed from bySoldierId exactly equals canonical edges.
The pair sets reconstructed from both indexes exactly equal one another.
No index value array contains duplicates.
traceability: The relation set records exact Git blob SHAs for every required source input and A-1 through A-5 contract used.
The validation result records the exact relation-set and index blob SHAs it validated.
A result for one relation-set blob may not be reused to approve another blob.

assertions: Soldier 105 remains a normal-form canonical identity.
No SP inheritance may be synthesized for Soldier 105 without an explicit SP_FORM_LINK.
Edges for Soldier 105 may only be supported by direct source kinds valid for a normal Soldier.
At least one canonical Hero relation must remain for this fixture when validating against the frozen baseline snapshot.
Soldier 247 validates the same normal-only composition rules outside the lancer fixture.
No army-type-specific relation inference is allowed.
No SP child relation may be inferred from numeric patterns or names.
Soldier 1032 remains normal-only despite its high numeric ID.
High ID values must not be interpreted as SP status or used for +5000/-5000 relation inference.
All canonical relations must still resolve through explicit IDs and allowed sources only.
An explicit SP_FORM_LINK 622 <-> 5622 must exist in the pinned SP Soldier snapshot.
Every eligible BASE_SOLDIER_HERO or normal-target SP_HERO_REWARD provenance on Soldier 622 must be represented on Soldier 5622 through SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT.
The pinned SP Soldier record has no second-stage unlock/expand branch; therefore Soldier 5622 must not contain SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND provenance derived from absent second-stage data.
Absence of second-stage fields is a valid first-stage-only branch, not missing-data repair input.
An explicit SP_FORM_LINK 320 <-> 5320 must exist in the pinned SP Soldier snapshot.
Every eligible normal-form direct provenance on Soldier 320 must be represented on Soldier 5320 through SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT.
Each pinned SecondStageExpandHeroList Hero ID must have canonical edge (heroId, 5320) with DIRECT SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND provenance.
SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND edges must remain additive and must not propagate backward to Soldier 320.

fixtureChangePolicy.rule: Pinned fixture expectations are evidence for the referenced source blob, not eternal game constants.
fixtureChangePolicy.whenSourceBlobChanges: Re-evaluate the affected fixture directly from the new source snapshot. A changed explicit SP link or SecondStageExpandHeroList is REVIEW until classified; do not force the old expectation onto new data.
fixtureChangePolicy.forbidden: Do not update fixture expectations merely to make a failing builder pass without source evidence.

classification: If counts and pair/provenance sets match the frozen source snapshot, record MATCH.
If counts differ because the source blobs changed, classify the exact added/removed pairs and provenance by sourceKind before PASS.
If counts differ while relevant source evidence is unchanged, treat as probable parser/JOIN/composition regression and FAIL until explained.
A count match alone is insufficient; semantic pair/provenance and index parity checks still must pass.

validationResultShape.statusRule: PASS requires zero hard-check failures, zero unresolved fixture failures, exact index parity, and no unresolved REVIEW classification.
validationResultShape.errorsRule: Every FAIL must include a machine-readable check ID plus the involved heroId/soldierId/sourceKind when applicable.
validationResultShape.reviewsRule: Every REVIEW must include the changed source blob evidence or explicit reason it cannot yet be classified.

completion: A-8 is complete when the relation layer has a frozen validation contract that can reject unsupported/missing/duplicated edges, invalid provenance or SP inheritance, stale bidirectional indexes, and unexplained regression differences, while preserving five representative structural fixtures for targeted diagnosis.
